title: Model profile, or the estate's set of them (DEC-0046)
description: A named, ordered list of catalogue model ids with a fallback policy (Fabric ADR-0147). The estate's profiles are Fabric's registry/model-profiles.json, a `model-profiles` document; an agent may declare a profile of its own.

models.description: Catalogue ids, first choice first. On a key route this list is the key's model allow-list.

fallback.description: none: only the first model the policy admits; between-turns: the next one after a failed turn, never within one.

agent.description: The agent that declares this profile for itself; absent: the estate's.
